_comment: Capability manifest — the APPROVED tool set per agent. tools/check_agent_security.py fails CI if any agent's frontmatter `tools:` grants a tool NOT listed here, if an agent is missing from this file, or if a privileged agent drops its escalation guardrails. Widening an agent's privilege is therefore a deliberate, reviewable edit to THIS file — not something that can slip through a prose change. Keep entries sorted. '*' = all tools (most privileged; use sparingly).
